attributes.name: Druva - UDA Correlated With Backup Disablement
attributes.description: Detects unusual data activity combined with backup disablement or pause for the same resource, indicating a potentially serious attempt to compromise data and recovery simultaneously.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects unusual data activity combined with backup disablement or pause for the same resource, indicating a potentially serious attempt to compromise data and recovery simultaneously.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.profile.name)
  )

| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.alert.name),
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL actor = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.id),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )

| EVAL is_uda =
    druva.uda.type IS NOT NULL
    OR event_text LIKE "*unusual data activity*"

| EVAL is_backup_disabled =
    event_text LIKE "*backup*disabled*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*disabled*backup*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*backup*paused*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*paused*backup*"

| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      is_uda
      OR is_backup_disabled
    )

| STATS
    uda_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_uda,

    disable_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE is_backup_disabled,

    first_uda =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE is_uda,

    first_disable =
      MIN(event_time)
        WHERE is_backup_disabled,

    uda_types =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.uda.type)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    uda_alert_names =
      VALUES(
        TO_STRING(druva.alert.name)
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    disable_event_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE is_backup_disabled,

    disable_actors =
      VALUES(actor)
        WHERE is_backup_disabled,

    uda_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_uda,

    disable_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      ) WHERE is_backup_disabled

  BY resource

| WHERE uda_count > 0
    AND disable_count > 0

| EVAL minutes_between =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      first_uda,
      first_disable
    )
